description: This is a Java source file defining the Recipe class, which models a cooking recipe along with nested RecipeStep objects. It provides methods for JSON serialization/deserialization, conversion to/from Android Bundles, and manages recipe data such as title, summary, image, ingredients, and steps.

classes.name: Recipe
classes.description: Represents a cooking recipe with title, summary, image, ingredients, and a list of steps. Includes methods for JSON serialization/deserialization and Bundle conversion.

classes.name: Recipe.RecipeStep
classes.description: Nested class representing an individual recipe step, including step image and text, with methods for conversion to and from Bundle.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a Recipe object from a JSON representation, parsing title, summary, image, ingredients, and steps.

methods.name: toBundle
methods.description: Serializes the Recipe object into an Android Bundle.

methods.name: fromBundle
methods.description: Deserializes a Recipe object from an Android Bundle.
